name: Nifty 50 · EMA 9 / EMA 21 · 1-hour candles
rule: BUY when a 1-hour candle closes with EMA 9 above EMA 21 (and you are flat). The order fills at the next candle's open.
EXIT when a 1-hour candle closes with EMA 9 below EMA 21. The order fills at the next candle's open.
Buy only. No stop. The trade is held overnight until the exit signal.
0.035% is charged on every buy and every sell. Rupees are for 1 NIFTY futures lot, lot size from the NSE F&O bhavcopy of the entry day.

now.what: EXIT when a 1-hour candle closes below about 23,474.44 (EMA 9 would drop under EMA 21).

limits: This rule was picked by testing many rules on 2023-24 and checking it on 2025-26. It made money in both, but less than simply holding Nifty in rising years.
Fills are assumed exactly at each candle's open; a real order slips a little. The 0.035% cost covers fees and about 1 point of slippage.
Rupees are for 1 lot of NIFTY futures, with no rollover cost and no margin interest. Futures roll every month in real life.
TradingView's 1-hour candles come from its own data feed; prices can differ by a few points, so a signal can be one candle apart.
Paper research. Not SEBI-registered advice. No orders are placed by this website.
